'''Chapter 1149''' is titled "One Second". 

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The first seven [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] and [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] at Bottakuri Maid Cafe.

==Short Summary==
[[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] swiftly overpowers [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]] and decapitates the [[Knights of God|Knight]] at the shoulders which he does not regenerate from. [[Ange]] sets fire to the [[Walrus School]] while [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] sets the [[Owl Library]] ablaze. As Gaban prepares to extinguish the blaze, [[Colon]] calls out to him, causing [[Gunko]] to go after the giant boy. [[Haki/Observation Haki|Foreseeing]] that the attack on his son will be fatal, Gaban surrenders and Gunko strikes him with several [[Aro Aro no Mi|arrows]], sending him falling into the Underworld. However, Gunko is then overcome by a memory of her past concerning [[Brook]], but as she heads toward him she is suddenly possessed by [[Nerona Imu|Imu]].

==Long Summary==
The restrained [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are amazed that [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] was able to actually injure [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]], who screams in pain as Gaban notes he has gotten rusty. Gaban then turns around and charges for Sommers, but Sommers uses his [[Iba Iba no Mi|thorns]] to create a barrier to block Gaban's attack while he backs up. Sommers asks Gaban why he is in [[Elbaph]] but Gaban says he does not want to bore him with the answer. As they fight, [[Nami]] tells everyone that she met Gaban at the castle and how even [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] were overwhelmed by his power, and also that he is [[Colon|Colon's]] father. [[Nico Robin|Robin]] identifies Gaban and [[Jinbe]] confirms he is considered [[Gol D. Roger|Roger's]] "left-hand", while [[Brook]] wonders why he is even here. [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] watches in curiosity that Gaban dealt actual damage to Sommers as Robin offers to aid using her [[Hana Hana no Mi|Devil Fruit powers]] even though she cannot move, but Jinbe warns her not to as Sommers can use thorns of iron, which will make for a bad matchup. Sommers then creates an entire field of thorns for which there is no safe spot to stand, but Gaban swiftly cuts Sommers in half before running of to rescue his son, leaving Sommers impaled on his own thorns. Chopper emerges from [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul's]] hair and starts chasing after him to figure out how Gaban was able to hurt Sommers.

Back at the [[Walrus School|school]], [[Ange]] has reluctantly lit it on fire while [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] sets fire to the [[Owl Library|library]] himself, to everyone else's sorrow. The giants tell [[Jarul]] to not blame himself for his decision as [[Gunko]] is informed that the buildings are burning, prompting her to tell [[Ronja]] to step backwards. Ronja, however, starts blaming herself for still being alive that the school and library are now burning, but the other kids and giants try to tell her that it is not. Gaban arrives at Gunko's position and angrily tells her that she has no right to take away anyone's culture, history, or even their children. Gunko sees him and says his defiance will mean she will kill the children as they all cheer for him to save them. In his mind, Gaban begs Colon not to say anything about their relationship, but it is all for naught as Colon calls him his father, which Gunko overhears. 

Quickly, Gunko dodges Gaban's attack and threatens to kill Colon by driving her arrow sword into his neck. Gaban figures if he attacks fast enough he can put out the fires and save the children and all of Elbaph, and he yells to Colon to hang on and give him one second to end it all, citing him as a big and strong boy. Colon agrees as Gaban thinks back to the day Colon was born and how he called him the greatest gift he could ever receive. However, Gunko starts driving the tip of her sword into his neck, and Gaban uses his advanced [[Haki/Observation Haki|Observation Haki]] to forsee that he will not be able to save Colon. As such, he drops his axes and surrenders, allowing Gunko to riddle him with her [[Aro Aro no Mi|arrows]] while calling him weak. As Gaban falls off the branch, he apologizes to his son and Elbaph for failing as Colon tearfully calls out to him. Chopper dives off of the branch to go after Gaban.

As a result of Colon's cries, Gunko begins to recall a memory from her past involving Brook back when he was still alive that leaves her shaken. Brook, meanwhile, muses over how similar Gunko looked to someone in his past as the crew try to get him to focus on escaping. Realizing that "Soul King" is Brook, Gunko immediately starts running towards his position, but is stopped by [[Nerona Imu|Imu]], who communicates with all three of the knights telepathically demanding to know why they are taking so long to recruit the giants because the [[Mary Geoise|Holy Land]] is currently burning and they need the strength of the giants now.  

As Imu possesses Gunko's body, they declare they will demonstrate the power of a god.  

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] overpowers [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]] and slices him in half.
**While unable to regenerate, Sommers' [[immortality]] keeps him alive.
**[[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] leaves his hiding place to find out how the immortal Sommers could be injured.
*[[Nami]] and the other [[Straw Hat Pirates]] discover "Ya-san" is Scopper Gaban and [[Silvers Rayleigh]]'s equal.
*[[Ange]] tearfully sets fire to the [[Walrus School]], while [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] burns down the [[Owl Library]] himself.
*Gaban tries to save [[Colon]] and the other children, but [[Gunko]] threatens to kill Colon before that.
**[[Haki/Observation_Haki#Future Vision|Sensing]] that he cannot save Colon in time, Gaban tearfully surrenders and Gunko [[Aro Aro no Mi|impales]] him and throws him off of the branches.
**Chopper notices Gaban's fall and jumps after him.
*Hearing Colon cry out for his father triggers a childhood memory in Gunko with [[Brook]] when he was alive, just as Brook realizes Gunko looks familiar.
*As Gunko recognizes Brook and heads towards him, a furious [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] telepathically contacts the three [[Knights of God]] and demands to know their progress.
**According to Imu, [[Mary Geoise]] is currently under attack.
**This chapter confirms that the Knights of God are aware of Imu existence.
*Having lost patience, Imu remotely possesses Gunko's body, who gains the same eyes as Imu has, and declares they will show [[Elbaph]] a god's power.
